mapper.select: SELECT t3.id FROM ( SELECT t1.*, t2.*, IF(FIND_IN_SET(parent_id, @pids) > 0, @pids := CONCAT(@pids, ',', id), '0') AS isChild FROM ( SELECT * FROM meter_device where tenant = 58197260 and deleted = 0 ORDER by device_name ,parent_id,id desc ) AS t1, ( SELECT @pids := #{deviceId} ) AS t2 ) t3 WHERE t3.isChild != '0'
